# Transferred dock items retain their former source edge in header state

## Context

Independent whole-file `WorkstationHeaderStatePopOutNL` run at `dev@633585423d2d7e8a33fd131ed265e199f110b5e2` reproduces the open #17844 row: after popping out Commits, the pane retains its provider and other header fields, but `dock.items.commits.edge` remains `right` instead of `null` (line124). Popup creation/adoption and the companion default-affordance arm pass.

## The Problem

The root provider continues to describe an edge it no longer owns. This is published state, not a popup paint or departure failure. A retained pane still resolves its original provider, so it can observe the obsolete source edge.

## The Architectural Reality

`VesselWorkspace.onTearOutDocumentChange` commits `workspaceSet.transfer({operation:'transferItem',...})`. Unlike standalone `detachItem`, `Operations.transferItem` removes the transferred item from the source catalog. `HeaderActionPolicy.publishDocument` then publishes only catalog members, and `Provider.setDataAtSameLevel` recursively merges leaves: omission does not reset an old leaf. The source's prior `edge` survives.

## The Fix

Keep ownership in `HeaderActionPolicy.publishDocument`: when a previously published item is absent from the new document, explicitly retire its source-edge value to `null` within the existing batched publication. Preserve the retained item's other fields and the popup's independently owned provider data. Do not change global Provider merge semantics or the transfer executor.

## Contract Ledger

| Surface | Authority | Required behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `dock.items.<id>.edge` | This workspace's committed document / `findOwningEdge` | Null once this workspace no longer owns the item's edge, including catalog removal during transfer | Explicit null | HeaderActionPolicy publication JSDoc | Real transfer/republication unit control and existing popup NL witness |
| Other header fields/provider hierarchy | Existing retained-pane contract | Preserved; each workspace publishes locally | Existing behavior | Existing docs | Popup/parent provider isolation and unchanged flags controls |

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A real transfer-style source document clears the old source edge without clearing retained flags or altering the target provider.
- [ ] A focused regression is red before the fix and green afterward; unchanged publication remains reactive-no-op.
- [ ] The unchanged whole `WorkstationHeaderStatePopOutNL` file passes on the repaired head.

## Out of Scope

Pane provider rebinding, item flag synchronization between workspaces, global Provider deletion semantics, virtual row-pool census, departure/VDOM fixes and film-tour work.
